# What the browser leg of `make ui-browser` needs beyond packages.txt: the host libraries of
# Playwright's WebKit build for Ubuntu 26.04 (its own list for this release, at the version
# tools/ui_board_browser.sh pins) and the fonts a page draws with. One package a line. Only the
# job that runs ui-browser installs this, and a Sprite that asks for it (`work run --browser`).
